lines:
sequenceDiagram
 participant UI as Chat maintenance queue
 participant Loop as Agent or model node
 participant Context as Core context selection
 participant Ledger as Semantic ledger
 participant Summary as Frozen summary provider
 participant Instructions as Workspace Instructions
 participant Model as Acting provider
 UI->>Context: Idle manual command with node and source version
 Loop->>Context: Next request or canonical context overflow
 Context->>Ledger: Restore Chat node branch child checkpoint plus settled delta
 Context->>Instructions: Reconcile surviving typed references
 Context->>Context: Measure pressure with compatible completed-turn usage anchor
 alt Qualified pressure or canonical overflow
  Context->>Ledger: Commit pruning replacements and checkpoint atomically
 end
 alt Reduction required or useful manual range
  Context->>Context: Select balanced prefix and retained tail
  Context->>Ledger: Commit start and immutable source identities
  Context->>Summary: Isolated prefix with original system tools and exact directive
  Summary-->>Context: Raw output and usage or failure
  Context->>Context: Check cancellation source generation and framed strict shrink
  alt Accepted summary
   Context->>Ledger: Commit replacement and checkpoint atomically
  end
  Context->>Ledger: Settle lifecycle exactly once and retain auxiliary usage
  Context->>Instructions: Restore missing baseline and active nested scopes
 end
 Context->>Ledger: Commit admitted context
 Context-->>UI: Settle maintenance without conversation messages
 UI->>Loop: Admit queued prompts FIFO using each settled history fence
 Context-->>Loop: Selection and changed generation
 Loop->>Model: Admitted request
 Model-->>Loop: Response or typed context overflow
 Note over Loop,Model: Retry requires a committed reduction. Original evidence is immutable. Auxiliary calls never execute tools.
 opt Explicit Chat fork
  UI->>Ledger: Copy selected document with source provenance and exact instruction owner-ID allowlist
  Ledger-->>Context: Independent child selection with no parent tool replay
 end
